description: Vitamin B12 is the commercial name for cyanocobalamin, a cobalt-containing cobamide (C₆₃H₈₈CoN₁₄O₁₄P, 1,355.4 Da). In research it is used as a cofactor source in one-carbon and methyl-transfer studies, as a reference standard in analytical method development, and as a medium supplement in cell-culture work. Solutions are photolabile, which is why handling and storage conditions are stated explicitly on every batch document.

faq.question: Is this product a lyophilized powder?
faq.answer: No. Vitamin B12 is supplied as a 10 mL multi-dose aqueous solution, so it is handled and stored differently from the lyophilized peptides in the catalogue.

faq.question: What concentration is the solution?
faq.answer: The concentration is stated on the Certificate of Analysis for each batch rather than being fixed in the catalogue, because the product is a formulated solution.

faq.question: Why must B12 be protected from light?
faq.answer: Cyanocobalamin is photolabile; exposure to light degrades the molecule, so vials are shipped and stored at 2–8 °C away from direct light.

faq.question: What is the CAS number of this product?
faq.answer: The catalogue lists CAS 68-19-9 with molecular formula C₆₃H₈₈CoN₁₄O₁₄P and a molecular weight of 1,355.4 Da.

faq.question: Can B12 be ordered with other items in one shipment?
faq.answer: Yes. Solution items ship alongside lyophilized kits in the same order; the tiered wholesale discounts apply to the combined kit count, not per product line.
